remarks: This WOW property features unmatched privacy on 5.5 acres.  Heavily wooded with two fenced areas off the house for easy access.  Clubhouse/cabin off of deck for imaginative use.  Exterior and interior entrances to the basement.  Interior and exterior entrance to in-law/auxiliary apartment.  Ability to use for extended family, living options and also great financial support.  Entering the property on the winding treed driveway it feels like you are entering a sanctuary.  2 year young furnaces and wood burning stove offers cozy comfort in winter, central air offers comfortable summer living.  Sunlight streams through the carefully placed windows.  Lots of character in this log home.  Enjoy spacious living areas and plenty of opportunity for privacy within the living space.  Open floor plan to country sized eat in kitchen and cathedral ceiling living room.  Second floor loft.  Large apartment with 3 bedrooms.  A must see remarkable property.
